correctness.rationale: Shortest paths split as 1_{labels differ}+absolute path-coordinate difference. A geodesic triple requires its middle label equal to an endpoint label and its layer between endpoint layers. Therefore any valid set uses each label once or exactly one label twice at p<q with all other labels used ≤1 inside (p,q). This partitions all subsets and yields (1+nz)^m plus m z² Σ_h(n-h-1)(1+hz)^(m-1). Maximality for adjacent repeats gives m(n-1) pairs; saturated interior repeats yield C_mn z^(m+1); nonextendible all-label single placements yield B_mn z^m by two-extreme inclusion-exclusion. Independently constructed the actual graph, BFS shortest paths and tested all 512 vertex subsets for K3□P3 and 4096 for K3□P4, including all one-vertex extensions. Coefficients respectively Ψ=(1,9,36,33,3), M:6z²+21z³+3z⁴; and Ψ=(1,12,66,88,18), M:9z²+34z³+18z⁴.
